item.title: When The Coupon Is Coup-Off, Part 2
item.description: Read When The Coupon Is Coup-Off, Part 2 Once I uploaded my pictures to their website and designed my mugs, I found that the 60% off coupon code was not valid, even though the expiration date was about two weeks away. I called the store, and was told, "I'm sorry, Corporate has cancelled that coupon". Read When The Coupon Is Coup-Off, Part 2

item.title: McMarkup
item.description: Read McMarkup Lunch Truck Guy: "Hundred burgers. Fifty plain, fifty with cheese." I look at my trainer, and I mouth "WTF?" My trainer just nods. The kitchen starts making the order for the guy, who has pulled around into the parking lot to wait without being told to; he's evidently done this before. Read McMarkup

item.title: Losing Their Cool
item.description: Read Losing Their Cool Me: "What're you gonna do?" Chef: "We cannot open the kitchen door, we have a lot of ice around the kitchen entrance, I'm gonna melt it." Me: "With salt?" Read Losing Their Cool

item.title: The Slice Is Thin, But My Patience Is Thinner
item.description: Read The Slice Is Thin, But My Patience Is Thinner Customer: "No! Thinner!" Me: "Sir, any thinner and it's just shredded meat." Customer: "Then give me that, then!" Me: "You misunderstand. There isn't a setting below this one. This is the thinnest I can make it." Read The Slice Is Thin, But My Patience Is Thinner

item.title: Has Baggage About The Bagging, Part 2
item.description: Read Has Baggage About The Bagging, Part 2 Me: "So that's just this milk in a bag, sir?" He proceeded to yell so loud that the next two lanes got quiet, and they were all staring at what was going on. Customer: "Are you f****** stupid? Do you have hearing problems? Where is your manager? They should fire you for being so stupid. I already said I wanted it in the bag!" Read Has Baggage About The Bagging, Part 2
